contests.notes: Original booklet printed total retained. The typed duplicate has handwritten corrections to Hayden county cells/total; those annotations are not silently substituted. Printed county/total difference retained: Carl Hayden: county sum 37,262; printed total 45,121.
Primary candidate county returns are transcribed from page 8. Two named write-ins are printed on page 9 as statewide totals only; no county allocation is supplied.
County cells visually verified against the published official table on page 8; Gila is 3,658.

notes: The supplied canvass contains statewide/federal returns, not legislative district returns. Source absence is not a claim that no legislative election occurred.

additional_sources.notes: Supplemental precinct returns or later typed canvass with handwritten corrections. Original published booklet is primary; overlapping races are not imported twice.
